result: PASS: simultaneous unchanged native, original retail MotS, and published browser MotS clients; movement, chat, reciprocal native/retail projectiles, native death/respawn and scores; browser-to-native actual projectile entities
character_scope: Default free-for-all, rank 7, Jedi personality. No MotS team/class-model qualification.
network: Private loopback-only namespace; GNS native, real DirectPlay retail, unchanged published browser transport

native_client.method: Recompile all four edited source files from the pinned base, reuse unchanged base objects and dependencies.

method: Ordinary keyboard input only for gameplay; bounded O_RDONLY process-memory snapshots validate state. No executable patch, memory write, injected gameplay command, or client engine change.

simultaneous_join.access: O_RDONLY bounded reads of exact task client; no writes or injection

retail_movement_applied.access: O_RDONLY bounded reads of exact task client; no writes or injection

native_short_movement.access: O_RDONLY bounded reads of exact task client; no writes or injection

native_respawn.access: O_RDONLY bounded reads of exact task client; no writes or injection

final.access: O_RDONLY bounded reads of exact task client; no writes or injection

normal_input_actions: Native and retail normal in-game chat; browser chat received by native.
Retail Up for 2 seconds; native observes changed applied position.
Native Ctrl pistol fire for 3 seconds, then a separate 5-second burst; browser and retail independently instantiate those projectile GUIDs.
Retail Ctrl pistol fire for 6 seconds; native independently instantiates matching projectile GUID 196859 with velocity (0,4,0).

Native Up for 0.7 seconds, then normal F1 camera cycle, Alt+Right for 1.5 seconds and Up for 4 seconds. A world death and ordinary respawn occurred during this movement; native sent DSS_DEATH and CreateThing, returned alive with health100, and acquired deaths1/suicides1/score-1. Original retail independently applied the new spawn and score.
Published browser ordinary Ctrl pistol fire; unchanged native independently instantiates the projectile GUIDs in browser_firing.

native_firing.method: O_RDONLY bounded reads; no writes, suspension, or injection

retail_firing.method: O_RDONLY bounded reads; no writes, suspension, or injection

browser_firing.method: O_RDONLY bounded reads; no writes, suspension, or injection

snapshot_offset.interpretation: Measured snapshot offset; exact coordinate convergence is not claimed. Both implementations contain thresholded velocity smoothing, but the cause of this observed offset was not isolated.

limitations: The first original MotS join timed out while its emulated software renderer initialized; the warmed original client rejoined and remained active for the recorded checks.
Initial across-room native pistol shots were instantiated by browser but did not reduce browser health or shields. Direct player-to-player damage and kill credit are not qualified by this test.
World death/respawn and its replicated score were tested; this does not claim a PvP kill.
No exhaustive maps, force powers, team/personality classes, mods, long-run load, WAN/NAT, or other native builds were qualified.
The default native MotS CreateThing reader profile targets the inspected pinned base; newer fixed-reader clients need the documented server environment option.
